void-indigo.$description: Void Indigo — Page background, primary surface — near-black with a violet undertone that makes the whole canvas feel tinted rather than neutral

abyss-plum.$description: Abyss Plum — Elevated card surface, shadow tone — a step lighter than Void Indigo, used to lift cards off the canvas with violet ambient

onyx.$description: Onyx — Deep contrast surface for cards, input fills, and the darkest band behind photo content

glacier.$description: Glacier — Off-white section backgrounds, light card surfaces — cool-tinted to harmonize with the violet system

paper.$description: Paper — Primary text on dark surfaces, button labels, image overlays — the dominant non-background color in the system

smoke.$description: Smoke — Secondary/muted body text, disabled labels

ash.$description: Ash — Tertiary text and subtle borders on light sections

graphite.$description: Graphite — Image borders, input strokes, secondary link text on light surfaces

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Button borders on light surfaces, heavy text emphasis

cinder.$description: Cinder — Input field borders, form dividers

pulse-blue.$description: Pulse Blue — Primary filled action background (CTA buttons, active nav) — the only chromatic fill in the system, acts as the single notification LED against the dark canvas

iris.$description: Iris — Outlined action border, secondary accent — the violet identity color applied to ghost buttons and decorative strokes

lavender-lightning.$description: Lavender Lightning — Outlined action border, gradient start — lighter violet for tertiary buttons and gradient origins

neon-sprout.$description: Neon Sprout — Link borders, icon borders, active state highlights — vivid green used sparingly as functional punctuation on links and tags

dusk-fade.$description: Dusk Fade — Gradient mid-stop — deep violet that bridges bright lavender to black in hero gradient washes

avenir.$description: Primary typeface across all contexts — headings, body, navigation, buttons, cards. Light 300 for large display headings creates a soft documentary feel; bold 700 for buttons and tag labels; regular 400 for body and supporting text.

poppins.$description: Rare single-use bold label — appears on one decorative badge/button context, providing a geometric contrast to Avenir's humanist curves
